stakeholders.name: VP of Sales (executive sponsor)
stakeholders.strategy: Weekly status syncs; involve directly in scope decisions; escalate blockers to them immediately since they can unblock budget and cross-team priority conflicts.

stakeholders.name: Finance (budget owner)
stakeholders.strategy: Monthly cost/ROI summary; do not over-communicate day-to-day details, but ensure they are never surprised by a budget variance.

stakeholders.name: Sales reps (end users)
stakeholders.strategy: Biweekly demos and a feedback channel; their adoption determines success, so keep them engaged even though they cannot unilaterally change scope or funding.

stakeholders.name: Legal/compliance
stakeholders.strategy: Light-touch monitoring via the existing data-handling checklist; re-engage only if the CRM's data model changes in a way that touches PII retention rules.

recommendation: Prioritize the VP of Sales (Manage Closely) for weekly alignment since they hold both the power to unblock the project and the interest to stay engaged; keep Finance satisfied with monthly ROI summaries rather than frequent updates; keep sales reps informed and gathering their feedback since they drive adoption; monitor Legal/compliance passively unless the data model changes.
